_comment: German-pivot repair for the Risk Register page title, which the >=2-pack agreement detector cannot see. These four packs do not ship byte-identical German -- they ship German run through their own script. Japanese リシコ and Korean 리시코 are phonetic transliterations of the German 'Risiko', not of the English 'risk' (which would be リスク / 리스크); Korean 레지스터 is likewise 'Register' sounded out rather than translated. Polish 'Zarejestruj sie' is the wrong sense entirely -- it is the sign-up verb, so the page announced itself as an account-creation form. Turkish 'Riskorekayit' is not a word. AGENT DRAFTS: each needs a native pass, landed now because a nav title in phonetic German is worse. Korean reuses the pack's own already-correct risks:title wording so the two keys stop disagreeing.
